source_brief.standout: Swapping bud, half-open and full-bloom contours creates a sculpted flower-opening effect.
source_brief.scene: A magical courtyard with three giant coral, pink and mint sculptural light flowers. Their petals are OPEN LED contour ribs in several stacked depth-separated replacement-shape layers, a bright full-bloom flower in hero, surrounding bud and intermediate petal frames dim. Four bottom storyboard cells show a closed bud, small opening, half-open blossom and broad full flower. Clay-animation softness of shape expressed in finite light ribs, no solid clay model.
